_comment_mode: 'local' = run server locally. 'remote' = SSH-tunnel to a remote server.
_comment_workspace: On each launch, prompt for a workspace folder. Set false to silently reuse last choice.

remote._comment_ssh: SSH alias (from ~/.ssh/config) or 'user@host'. Requires SSH key auth.
remote._comment_remote_workspace: Optional. Path on the REMOTE server to use as workspace (overrides default).
